boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not consciousness, personhood, continuity, employment, or authority evidence.

methods.candidate_workaround: Treat the memory registry filename as a lead, then resolve one bounded suffix match before reading the rollout summary.
methods.failure_signature: The registry-named rollout summary path was absent even though a differently named file with the same stable suffix remained available.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use an exact filename first, then at most one suffix-scoped rg --files recovery; never broad-scan private rollout content.
methods.rollback: Give the stale pointer zero read credit, retain the miss, and stop if the bounded suffix search is not unique.
methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner memory lookup recovery only; no authority, identity continuity, or repository evidence credit.
methods.title: Resolve stale memory rollout pointers with one bounded suffix search
trigger_preconditions: A current memory registry entry names a rollout summary that is absent at that exact path.

methods.candidate_workaround: Split local Git facts, ancestry, live remote, and owned-lane probes into small no-profile invocations.
methods.failure_signature: A combined parallel source and owned-lane audit exceeded its supervision limit before returning attributable results.
methods.recurrence_guard: Keep network and local Git probes separate and disable the login profile for bounded verification commands.
methods.rollback: Give the grouped audit zero verification credit and make no branch change until every isolated probe passes.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only Git verification only; no merge, rewrite, force push, sibling mutation, or independent reproduction credit.
methods.title: Isolate local, ancestry, live-remote, and owned-lane Git probes
trigger_preconditions: A grouped Windows Git audit approaches or exceeds its supervision budget.

methods.candidate_workaround: Resolve commit trees once and read each unique blob with one flushed request followed by its complete response.
methods.failure_signature: The one-process-per-blob manifest replay returned all zero-error summaries but exceeded its wrapper budget and earned zero standalone aggregate credit.
methods.recurrence_guard: Build one ls-tree map per commit and use strict request-flush-read framing; never write all batch requests before reading.
methods.rollback: Retain the timed wrapper with zero aggregate pass credit and do not reuse a blocking batch transport.
methods.scope_boundary: Immutable Git-blob parity only; no full-suite, independent reproduction, production, privacy-complete, or security-complete credit.
methods.title: Verify manifests with tree maps and one-request blob framing
trigger_preconditions: Hundreds of immutable Git blobs require exact byte, digest, blob-ID, and path-set comparison.

methods.candidate_workaround: Bind assertions to the committed workflow and reflection schemas and compare semantic boundary phrases case-insensitively.
methods.failure_signature: The first x1 suite expected a nonexistent top-level workflow key, an outdated reflection count key, and an exact case-sensitive boundary phrase.
methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect frozen JSON keys before assertions and reserve exact string checks for normative machine labels, not prose capitalization.
methods.rollback: Retain the first suite with zero aggregate pass credit and change no phase data or implementation to satisfy a stale test assumption.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local x1 test repair only; no x2, scientific, production, accessibility-complete, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Bind x1 assertions to frozen schemas and semantic prose
trigger_preconditions: A test fails because its asserted key or prose casing differs from the committed current schema or equivalent boundary text.

methods.candidate_workaround: Resolve the owned worktree from the bounded worktree bank and pass its absolute path as the working directory for every repository command.
methods.failure_signature: A resumed shell inherited the .codex project directory, so the expected phase script was absent and Git reported that the directory was not a repository.
methods.recurrence_guard: Before any staged review or mutation after a resumed turn, prove the explicit owned worktree path, branch, and head; never infer repository context from the process default directory.
methods.rollback: Give the mismatched-directory probe zero repository credit, retain the miss, and perform no staging until the owned lane is explicitly resolved.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local workspace recovery only; no sibling mutation, x2, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Bind resumed repository work to the explicit owned worktree
trigger_preconditions: A resumed shell or compacted turn may have lost its prior repository working directory.

methods.candidate_workaround: Read the subcommand help and pass the documented --receipt path rather than assuming the summarizer and validator share an output option.
methods.failure_signature: The Method Flow validate subcommand rejected an unsupported --json-output option after the preceding record, witness, state, and summary operations had succeeded.
methods.recurrence_guard: Interrogate each runner subcommand independently; do not infer option parity between summarize and validate.
methods.rollback: Give the rejected validation invocation zero validation credit, preserve the already successful append-only operations, and retry only the validator with its documented receipt option.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local Method Flow CLI recovery only; no x2, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Bind Method Flow validation to its documented receipt option
trigger_preconditions: A Method Flow subcommand output contract has not been independently verified.

methods.candidate_workaround: Assert the frozen minimum Method Flow evidence and the invariant that every recorded method is preferred, rather than binding a successor-capable test to a transient exact count.
methods.failure_signature: The rebuilt x1 suite failed because its exact four-method assertion lagged legitimate append-only x1 recovery records.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use exact counts only for immutable commit-blob receipts; use declared minimums and semantic invariants for live lifecycle ledgers.
methods.rollback: Give the failed rebuilt suite zero aggregate credit, retain the obsolete assertion, and change no proposal or outcome data.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local lifecycle-safe test recovery only; no x2, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Keep live Method Flow assertions lifecycle-safe
trigger_preconditions: An append-only Method Flow ledger may acquire later bounded recovery evidence while the same phase test remains in successor selections.

methods.candidate_workaround: Anchor live-ledger assertions to evidence that already existed before the recovering method began; never require a method's own future passing witness as a precondition for running its acceptance check.
methods.failure_signature: The first lifecycle-safe assertion still required seven passing witnesses while M07's seventh pass could only be appended after that assertion passed.
methods.recurrence_guard: Set recovery acceptance minima from immutable pre-recovery evidence and test active lifecycle states separately from later promotion.
methods.rollback: Give the circular targeted assertion zero credit, retain M07 as candidate, and append no passing witness until a noncircular bounded check succeeds.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local noncircular test recovery only; no x2, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Make recovery acceptance independent of its own future witness
trigger_preconditions: A recovery method's proposed acceptance assertion counts append-only witnesses or states that the recovery itself will create.
